record.title: Guide to Evaluation Perspectives on AI Safety in the Healthcare Sector: Toward the Realization of Trustworthy AI
record.original_title: ヘルスケア領域におけるAIセーフティ評価観点ガイド
record.short_title: J-AISI Healthcare AI Safety Evaluation Guide
record.issuing_body: Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI), Healthcare Sub-Working Group of the Business Demonstration Working Group
record.summary: Sector guide by the Japan AI Safety Institute's Healthcare Sub-Working Group that applies the ten evaluation perspectives of J-AISI's Guide to Evaluation Perspectives on AI Safety to healthcare. It covers AI providers whose products build on pre-trained text-generating LLMs and are not Software as a Medical Device, and for each perspective, from control of toxic output and prevention of misinformation to data quality and verifiability, sets out healthcare-specific risks, actual cases and example evaluation items, including the risk that such products are used as de facto medical devices. It explains evaluation in five phases from product design to deployment and operation, with a checklist.
record.notes: J-AISI's list of outputs dates the release 2 April 2026; the Japanese and English covers are dated 3 April 2026. J-AISI also published summaries, Markdown versions of chapters 3 and 4 for use with AI services, and, in Japanese, practical examples of AI safety evaluation with prompts and agent skills. Products that qualify as Software as a Medical Device are left to the approval and certification framework of the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Act. The guide is a living document, to be updated as generative AI and regulation evolve.

verification.note: Stored: J-AISI's bilingual release page on aisi.go.jp, the Japanese guide version 1.0 (118 pages, 令和 8 年 4 月 3 日), the English guide (98 pages) and English summary, both dated April 3, 2026, and J-AISI's list of Information outputs, which dates the release 2 April 2026. They confirm the title, the issuer, the scope and the content; the summary is checked against the Japanese text. date_published follows the date on the documents; the listing date is in notes. The English edition carries no translation notice and is listed beside the Japanese edition, so it is treated as an authentic text.

judgment.status_reasoning: Version 1.0 released by J-AISI in April 2026 as practical, non-binding guidance; no later version is shown.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A sector-specific AI safety evaluation guide of an AI safety institute: in scope with no note. JP-03's notes say the domain guides are not recorded separately, so this is not a duplicate.
judgment.date_reasoning: The Japanese cover (令和 8 年 4 月 3 日) and the English covers give 3 April 2026; J-AISI's list of outputs dates the release 2 April 2026. Following the rule to take a guideline's date from the document itself, date_published is 2026-04-03 and the listing date is in notes.
